purpose: One-time final evaluation of Models 2 and 3 (L2 logistic regression) on SYNTHETIC outcomes. Frozen before any test label is read.
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC OUTCOMES — NOT VALIDATED WORLD BANK RISK ACCURACY

m2.review_threshold: max F1 on refit out-of-fold probabilities, alert rate <= 30% (assumed review capacity: up to 30% of contracts); shown as a demonstration review list only

m3.feature_policy: m3_v2_clean (notice_type removed; rare levels grouped at min_frequency = ceil(20 / refit prevalence); window and project age winsorised at refit p1/p99)
m3.output: Low / Medium / High simulated risk band (probability kept for evaluation)
m3.risk_bands: High >= q90 of refit out-of-fold probabilities, Medium q70..q90, Low < q70 (v2 rule)
m3.alert_threshold: max F1 on refit out-of-fold probabilities, alert rate <= 30% (reported, secondary)

procedure.cv: GroupKFold(5) by project_id on the refit population; scoring average_precision
procedure.preprocessing: fitted inside each training fold (OneHot min_frequency, median imputation, winsorisation where declared, log1p window, StandardScaler)
procedure.oof: cross_val_predict with the selected C (5-fold grouped) for thresholds and bands
procedure.explanations: logistic contributions (coef x transformed value) aggregated to original features; bid-window features (deadline_status, has_positive_window, window_days) shown as one 'Bid window' factor; country contributions and design columns with project-bootstrap sign agreement < 0.8 (20 resamples) pooled as 'other factors' and not displayed as drivers

probability: mean predicted probability vs realised and assumed prevalence
metrics.generalisation: test rows in projects absent from the refit population
metrics.m3_bands: count, share, realised simulated event rate, ordering check (Low < Medium < High), most frequent displayed factors
metrics.null_control: S0: ROC-AUC CI must contain 0.5 and PR-AUC CI must contain the realised prevalence

disclosures: Scenario-level realised test prevalence was printed in the synthetic-data reports (constants.json) before this evaluation; the evaluation is not fully blind.
The Model 3 feature policy was chosen in one pre-declared validation comparison (ml/eda/stage3b_m3_cleanup_*).
The Stage 3A risk-band rule was revised (v1 -> v2) after a degenerate empty band appeared in training out-of-fold shares.
